subject: Building Construction
preamble: The Building Construction syllabus is designed to assess candidates' basic knowledge of building construction principles, safety practices, drawing interpretations, structural elements, services, and management required for building projects.
aims: knowledge of basic safety rules, practices, and protective measures in building construction;
understanding of the roles, functions, and relationships of members in the construction team;
ability to identify, select, use, and maintain basic construction tools, equipment, and plants;
skill in reading, interpreting, and producing building drawings and construction details;
understanding of site preparation, excavation, structural elements, services, and finishes in building construction;
knowledge of basic principles of business management, book keeping, and contract work in the building industry.

papers.title: Objective Questions
papers.details: Forty multiple-choice objective questions, all of which must be answered.

papers.title: Short-Structured Essay Questions
papers.details: Five short-structured essay questions. Candidates will be required to answer any four.

papers.title: Practical Test
papers.details: Consists of two regional sections. Section A (Building Drawing for Nigeria, Sierra Leone, The Gambia): 4 questions including a compulsory one (answer compulsory + 2 others). Section B (Ghana only): 6 essay questions including a compulsory one (answer compulsory + 3 others).

topics.title: 1. Introduction to Building
topics.notes: Definition of building; classification and types; introduction to National Building Codes (Building regulations and Byelaw requirements).

topics.title: 2. Building Construction and Construction Team
topics.notes: Definition, purpose, and procedures for building construction; parties in the construction team (Client's team, contractor's team, and statutory personnel); functions of team members; relationship of the parties.

topics.title: 3. Safety Practices
topics.notes: Definition of safety, rules, and regulations; hazards in the workshop and construction site; causes and methods of accident prevention; safety equipment and measures at construction sites; first aid equipment, procedures, and safety wear; safety in working with dangerous equipment and materials (electricity, scaffolding, formwork, cement, roofs, etc.).

topics.title: 4. Basic Tools, Equipment, and Machines
topics.notes: Identification and functions of basic tools and equipment; care and maintenance of tools and equipment.

topics.title: 5. Site Clearing and Levelling
topics.notes: Operations involved in site clearing; tools and equipment for site clearing and levelling; basic site levelling operations.

topics.title: 6. Site Organization and Layout
topics.notes: Preliminary operations in building construction; procedure for site layout; location, boundary lines, hoarding, hutments, and access roads.

topics.title: 7. Setting Out
topics.notes: Methods of setting out (3:4:5 method, Builder's square method); tools and equipment for setting out; procedures for setting out.

topics.title: 8. Building Drawing
topics.notes: Use of drawing tools and simple exercises on plane geometry in relation to building; building drawing symbols; scales used in building and their application on site; production drawings and interpretations (plans, elevations, sections, and details); special details (detailing building elements including doors and windows schedule); scaling (enlargement, pictorial, and perspectives); definitions and use of Auto-CAD.

topics.title: 9. Excavation and Earthwork
topics.notes: Classifications, types, and properties of soil; definition and function of excavation; methods of excavation; tools, equipment, and plant used for excavation; solution to excavation problems (earthwork support, timbering, battering, and dewatering); safety rules during excavations.

topics.title: 10. Foundations
topics.notes: Definition, purpose, and functional requirements of foundations; types of foundations; factors determining the choice of foundation.

topics.title: 11. Ground Floors
topics.notes: Types, functions, and functional requirements of ground floors; methods of constructing ground floors; definition of basement; differences between buildings with and without basements; problems relating to basements in a building.

topics.title: 12. Suspended Floors
topics.notes: Definition and functions of upper floors; methods of constructing concrete floors and timber upper floors.

topics.title: 13. Concrete
topics.notes: Definition and types of concrete; materials for concrete; definitions, types, components, and manufacture of cement; properties and uses of cement including alternative products (e.g., Pozzolana, Pulverized Fuel Ash [P.F.A.], Rice Husk Ash [R.H.A.]); types and uses of aggregates (including alternative aggregates like palm kernel shells, periwinkle, etc.); types and uses of reinforcements; properties and characteristics of concrete; concrete production processes; types of concrete tests.

topics.title: 14. Walls
topics.notes: Definition, types, and functions of walls; definition, types, and properties of walling materials (including locally sourced materials); manufacturing processes of walling materials (clay, bricks, blocks, concrete blocks); sizes of blocks and bricks; mortar mixes for brickwork; methods of wall construction; timber wall construction.

topics.title: 15. Doors and Windows
topics.notes: Definition and functions of wall openings; methods of constructing wall openings; functions of lintels and arches; definition, functions, and types of doors and windows; methods of fixing door and window frames.

topics.title: 16. Staircases
topics.notes: Definition, classification, types, and uses of stairs; materials used for the construction of stairs; materials used for finishing staircases.

topics.title: 17. Roofs
topics.notes: Definition, purpose, and types of roofs; functional requirements of roofs; materials used for roofs; roof covering materials; protection of roofs from wind, rain, lightning, etc.

topics.title: 18. Plumbing Installations and Drainage Systems
topics.notes: Types of fittings in plumbing and sanitary works; materials for plumbing works and fittings; types of sanitary appliances; soil and waste appliances; installation of sanitary appliances; terms used in drainage works; principles and functional requirements of drainage systems; types of drainage systems; types of drainage materials (pipes and fittings); methods of laying and testing drain lines; description of septic tanks, soakaways, inspection chambers, manholes, etc.

topics.title: 19. Electrical Installations and Solar Energy Systems
topics.notes: Electrical symbols, installation terms, and materials; identification and uses of electrical wiring materials; types of electrical wiring; definition, functions, and components of solar energy systems.

topics.title: 20. Finishes (Floors, Walls, Ceilings)
topics.notes: Floors: types, characteristics, laying methods, uses, care, and maintenance of floor finishes. Walls: types, characteristics, plastering, rendering, and methods of applying mix. Ceilings: types, functions, and ceiling finishing materials.

topics.title: 21. External Works
topics.notes: Types of fences, materials for fencing, and fence construction; types of gates, fixing, and production of gates; types and materials for constructing access roads; construction of access roads; needs and materials for landscaping; procedures for landscaping.

topics.title: 22. Business Organizations and Capital in Building
topics.notes: Principles and management of business organizations in the building industry; types of business organizations in the building industry; types and sources of capital.

topics.title: 23. Book Keeping
topics.notes: Book keeping in small-scale businesses; books of original entries.

topics.title: 24. Contract Work
topics.notes: Definition and types of contracts; contract documents; parties to a contract.
